description: This Java source file defines a utility class ConnectionMigrationUtil for migrating persisted JSON representations of Connection objects to the current JSON structure. It includes methods and nested classes for migrating source filters, topic/action/subject placeholders, and authorization contexts within Connection JSON documents.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods and nested classes to perform migration of JSON representations of Connection objects to the latest structure.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateSourceFilters
classes.description: A nested class implementing a unary operator to migrate source filter fields to the new enforcement format.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateTopicActionSubjectFilters
classes.description: A nested class implementing a unary operator to migrate topic:action|subject placeholders to the new format across sources and targets.

classes.name: ConnectionMigrationUtil.MigrateAuthorizationContexts
classes.description: A nested class implementing a unary operator to migrate deprecated global authorization contexts into source and target authorization contexts.

methods.name: connectionFromJsonWithMigration
methods.description: Static method that takes a JsonObject representing a Connection and applies necessary migrations before creating and returning a Connection instance.
